key.name: profiles
key.description: One JSON object per entry with the keys name, dir, enabled and chain. The dir is a Claude Code config directory, the value CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR would be set to, and identifies the profile.

key.name: panel-source
key.description: highest shows the profile closest to its limit, active shows the most recently updated one, profile pins panel-profile and all shows every enabled profile side by side.

key.name: panel-profile
key.description: Config directory pinned when panel-source is profile.

key.name: panel-limit
key.description: The rate limit window rendered in the panel button.

key.name: panel-format
key.description: Whether the panel shows the gauge icon, the percentage or both.

key.name: hide-when-stale
key.summary: Hide the panel button without fresh data
key.description: Hide the indicator when no profile has reported within stale-after-minutes instead of dimming it.

key.name: warning-threshold
key.description: Percentage at which usage is rendered as a warning.

key.name: critical-threshold
key.description: Percentage at which usage is rendered as critical.

key.name: notify-threshold
key.description: Send a notification when a profile crosses a threshold upwards.

key.name: stale-after-minutes
key.summary: Age at which data counts as stale
key.description: Payloads only arrive while a Claude Code session renders its status line, so data older than this is marked stale.

key.name: refresh-seconds
key.description: How often the rendered countdowns are recomputed. Usage values themselves arrive through a file monitor, not by polling.

key.name: state-dir
key.description: Directory the status line wrapper writes to. Empty means $XDG_STATE_HOME/claude-usage.
